purpose: test whether equal-initial-notional opposite Binance XAUUSDT and PAXGUSDT perpetual positions produce a persistent market-direction-independent funding spread after relative mark-basis drift and conservative hurdles

mechanism_evidence.PAXG_unit: one token represents one fine troy ounce of London Good Delivery gold
mechanism_evidence.XAU_description: Binance XAUUSDT is a USDT-settled gold perpetual rather than owned tokenized gold

historical_contract.ordering: ascending fundingTime within each response after validation

causal_analysis.selection: choose the direction with the higher training net only
causal_analysis.funding_cashflow: fixed entry quantities times each settlement markPrice times signed fundingRate
causal_analysis.relative_mark_basis_PnL: fixed entry quantities marked from each role entry to role exit
causal_analysis.candidate_gate: selected direction strictly positive after all frozen hurdles in training validation and test with complete aligned common history and no unexpected gaps
causal_analysis.accepted_edge: never from this preflight; exact account fees margin liquidation index divergence capacity and prospective cross-regime recurrence remain required

one_use_outcomes.negative_or_incomplete: terminalize this historical preflight until a material funding index fee or product architecture change
one_use_outcomes.positive_all_roles: freeze a separate prospective synchronized basis funding liquidity and cross-regime study without trading
one_use_outcomes.all_outcomes: no credentials accounts positions orders or trading authority and accepted edge count unchanged
